gaps: P2: nothing usable (#16, credited to Kraus 1687, is a copy of Merian’s 1644 view with a doubtful date and low resolution; #12/#17 are single buildings); no second P3 or P4
notes: #4 (colored woodcut view with verses, dated 1572, maker unknown) is a vivid alternative for P1 but its source is unrecorded. #3 is a higher-resolution colored copy of the same Chronicle woodcut as #1, without the title. #11/#13 (Merian’s Marktplatz, colored copy dated 1656) come from Topographia Bavariae, 1644, so they fall in P1, not P2. #25 (New Town Hall photochrom) is a strong landmark alternative to #24. #14 is Venice (a Canaletto in the Alte Pinakothek).
